hypothesis: A decoder-rebuilt map from completed Wiki link targets to prior exact piped surface realizations can predict future surface WRT events after the target and pipe are known, exposing cross-surface redundancy without changing or separately encoding the FX2/WRT stream.
kill_condition: The development-selected policy is non-positive on held-out exact arithmetic bytes, regresses any held-out block by more than 8 bytes, or projects below 200 gross bytes per 1M raw bytes plus compressed implementation cost.
promotion_condition: The exact endpoint428 shadow clears 200 gross bytes per 1M plus compressed source cost on heldout data with bounded block regressions, then transfers under a frozen policy to a disjoint corpus window before native integration.
rejection_reason: Park this realization as a rejected proposal: both external evidence inputs are absent on this host and its declared 200000-byte full-corpus expectation cannot independently cover the 1389323-byte design-target debt. title: Causal marginalized link-target surface continuation
